高考英语3500词 · 05英文原文

The Great President

伟大的总统 · 166 词 · 3 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1As the founder of the republic, the president had many good qualities. Before coming to power, he was a generous lawyer. He was willing to selflessly help everyone who turned to him. He accepted no fee for giving legal guidance and advice to people who were out of work or had no formal education. Later, believing all mankind to be equal, he devoted himself to overturning laws that discriminated against Black people. He set up the Black Youth League and was voted in as its leader. However, though he stood by his peaceful principles and rejected violence and terror, his mean enemies still blew up his house and attacked his relatives, and he himself was sentenced to 30 years in prison.

2Unafraid of the prison guards’ cruelty, he stayed active and never begged them for mercy. As a matter of fact, he was always hopeful and never lost heart throughout that difficult time.

3Finally, people made him their leader and honoured him with a gold-coloured blanket.

高考英语3500词 · 05中文译文

伟大的总统

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1作为这个共和国的创立者，总统身上有许多好品质。执政前，他是位慷慨的律师，愿意无私地帮助每一个向他求助的人。他免费给失业者和没受过教育的人提供法律指导和意见。后来，因为相信人人平等，他投入到废除歧视黑人的法律的行动中。他成立了黑人青年联盟，并当选为领导人。他坚持以和平方式行事，反对暴力和恐怖手段，卑鄙的敌人却炸毁了他的家，袭击他的亲人。他自己也未能逃过三十年的监禁判决。

2他不怕狱警的残酷，依旧积极地生活，从未向他们求饶。其实，那段日子虽然艰难，他始终抱有希望，没有灰心。

3最后，人们推举他担任领导人，并送给他一条金色的毯子作为嘉奖。
